scripts.dev:admin: npm --prefix .. run build:admin && wrangler dev --config admin/wrangler.jsonc --port 8788 --persist-to api/.wrangler/state
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p api/test/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p admin/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p admin/test/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply pem-pathfinder-store --local --config api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply pem-pathfinder-store --remote --config api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:export:remote: mkdir -p api/.wrangler && wrangler d1 export pem-pathfinder-store --remote --config api/wrangler.jsonc --table honors --table clubs --table settings --no-schema --output api/.wrangler/fill.sql
scripts.deploy:admin: npm --prefix .. run build:admin && wrangler deploy --config admin/wrangler.jsonc
